Class OccludingEntity

java.lang.Object
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.entity.Entity
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.entity.OccludingEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Renderable, fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.shadow.ShadowCaster, Comparable<Renderable>
public final class OccludingEntity extends Entity
An upright structure that can occlude characters at another elevation. Marks walls and supporting columns, not flat floor tiles.
